_comment: WHICH BRANCHES MAY NOT REACH master ON AI JUDGEMENT ALONE.
Written 2026-09-13 after six capability-branch merges landed on master in one session
without Tom's word. His ruling: 'Really you should never merge a major branch to master
without my all-clear on completion.' The harm is not a broken build -- every one of those
merges was green -- it is that GREEN IS NOT DONE. A passing suite says the code works; it
says nothing about whether the FEATURE is finished, and only Tom can answer that.
A branch listed here needs a matching entry in dev/branch-all-clears.json, pinned to the
exact commit cleared, before dev/hooks/pre-merge-commit will let it into master.
A branch NOT listed here is an ordinary track -- a defect fix, a doc change, a tooling
change -- and merges on the existing rules: green check_all on the merge result, and the
pre-push stamp. That distinction is the whole design. Do not list everything; a gate that
stops all work is a gate somebody switches off.
A FREEZE stops EVERY merge into master, including ordinary tracks, except one marked
'hotfix:' in its merge subject. Set active true and state until and why. Tom, 2026-09-13:
'We do want to continue development right through the EWB meeting, but we can't do that

It is ON as of 2026-09-13. It was OFF for the first draft of this file, on the reasoning that he had asked for the all-clear gate rather than a freeze -- and that was wrong: the freeze was already in dev/session-handoff.md, set on 2026-09-10, and had simply never been read.
freeze.until: after EWB, which is 17 September (Tom, 2026-09-13, correcting this repository). Lift on his word, not on a date.
freeze.why: Tom, 2026-09-13: "We do want to continue development right through the EWB meeting, but we cant do that if we are merging our work to master." His plan of 2026-09-10 already said it: "4 days of bugs, then 2 days of translation, not earlier" -- dev/session-handoff.md section 5, "Bugs only until the freeze". Six capability merges went in on 09-13 against that plan because nobody had read it.
